observations: A rounded, stuffed-toy-like figure sits centered on a flat yellow field; its body is built from overlapping blobs of ochre, pink, grey-green and pale blue, with black outlines tracing each swollen limb.
Two eyes are ringed by tight yellow spirals on a dark ground, and a small black nose sits above a mouth showing white teeth; jagged black marks at the crown read as a tuft of hair.
Loose red, pink and dark-blue scribble lines run across the torso and face, sitting visibly on top of the colour fills rather than blending into them.
reading: The figure reads as a toy made uneasy: the rounded, balloon-like forms suggest softness, but the layered scribbles and spiral eye rings pull against that comfort. The flat yellow surround keeps the mood open rather than threatening. What might be read as innocence and unease share the same surface without one cancelling the other.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between nnxyz nnotb #110 and nnxyz nnotb #112 in both title-derived and recorded-creation order.
